'''Hoylin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="WbC" /> located in the [[Hoylin system/Legends|Hoylin system]], a part of the [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Aikhibba system/Legends|Aikhibba]] and [[Beris system/Legends|Beris systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rodin Baem]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at Hoylin<ref name="WbC" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="BaemDate">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Furthermore, since ''Wanted by Cracken'' states that [[Rodin Baem]] is age 30, he must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].</ref> a fact that was noted<ref name="WbC" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="BaemDate" /> by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hoylin was mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hoylin system, and therefore Hoylin itself, in grid square P-13.<ref name="TEA" />
